ORDINANCE Sepr \3, 2023

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 17-I in the area bounded by:

a line 237.20 feet north of and parallel to West North Shore Avenue; the public alley next
west of North Rockwell Street; a line 303.20 feet north of and parallel to West North
Shore Avenue; and North Rockwell Street

to those of a RT3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 6724-28 North Rockwell Street
